policy: Files listed under 'files' are the immutable input to the named revision. A migration replays this exact content on every future 'upgrade head' (a fresh dev/staging/prod database, a downgrade/upgrade round trip, CI). Editing one of these files would silently change what that already-applied revision seeds on a database that has not seen it yet, while databases that already ran it keep the old content -- two environments both at the same revision id with different data. Do not edit a listed file. To change or add rule content, create a new *.yaml file and a new migration that seeds it, per docs/DATABASE_CONVENTIONS.md section 25.4. tests/database/test_seed_idempotency.py enforces this by recomputing each file's sha256 and comparing it to the value recorded here.
